LESSON: TAWAKKUL

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Pillars of Iman
Topic 3.3: Tawakkul

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Tawakkul. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: which Muslims can practise tawakkul in their daily life. 1. How can a Muslim show reliance on Allah?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify the qualities of a mutawakkil as a basis for character building
2. practise tawakkul in day-to-day life

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. identify the qualities of a mutawakkil as a basis for character building
   In simple words: practise until you can identify the qualities of a mutawakkil as a basis for character building. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. practise tawakkul in day-to-day life
   In simple words: practise until you can practise tawakkul in day-to-day life. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Tawakkul using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Tawakkul in the examples.
2. Explain Tawakkul to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Tawakkul.
4. Show that you can: identify the qualities of a mutawakkil as a basis for character building

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Tawakkul using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Tawakkul important for a Grade 6 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Brainstorm and identify the qualities of a mutawakkil and display them on the notice board ((Q.3:160, Q5:23, Q65:3),
2. Sort the qualities of a mutawakkil using a digital device/pocket board/flash cards,
3. Discuss the significance of tawakkul in the life of a Muslim and make summary notes,
4. Digital Literacy: interacting with digital technology enhanced as learners sort and match the qualities of a mutawakkil.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. which Muslims can practise tawakkul in their daily life. 1. How can a Muslim show reliance on Allah?
2. Why is tawakkul important to a Muslim?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify the qualities of a mutawakkil as a basis for character building
2. practise tawakkul in day-to-day life

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
